subject: SOC 2 Type II report + scoped authn evidence for HealBridge audit
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@healbridge.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healbridge.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2 Type II + bridge letter and scoped MFA/log slices for HealBridge audit

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well. We're starting our external audit with Crowell & Park and need a couple of items from Redwood to complete our evidence pack. Can you confirm you can provide the following by 2027-08-15?

1) The latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is ok) and a signed bridge letter if the report period doesn't fully cover our audit window.
2) Scoped authn evidence covering our audit period (requested window below): MFA enrollment changes, successful/failed sign-ins, and token refresh events. We only need slices for user-principals tied to HealBridge org IDs — sample CSV is fine.
3) A recent access review snapshot (who had admin/service-account access on 2027-06-30) and the documented privileged account deprovisioning runbook reference.

Audit window: 2027-05-01 to 2027-06-30 (please confirm if you need a larger window).
Acceptable formats: CSV for logs, PDF for reports/bridge. If there are redaction rules we need to follow (PII, IP obfuscation), please tell us.

Thank you — this is time-sensitive for our auditor.

Regards,
Maria Gomez
Senior IT Audit Manager | HealBridge
Maria.Gomez@healbridge.com
+1 415-555-1298

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@healbridge.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 Type II + bridge letter and scoped MFA/log slices for HealBridge audit

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list. We can support all three asks; a few clarifying questions so we scope precisely: 

• Audit window: you listed 2027-05-01 to 2027-06-30 — is that the full period your auditor wants tested or do they prefer a 12-month overlap with our SOC2 period? If you need cross-period coverage we can include a bridge letter.
• Log slice granularity: do you need every auth event for HealBridge-principal identities, or a sampled extract (e.g., 10% sample or targeted users listed)? Full extracts can be large; CSV with event_type, timestamp, username, outcome, client_ip (we can redact IPs) is typical.
• Access review snapshot: we can provide a CSV for 2027-06-30 that includes username, role, last_activity, and how access was granted. Confirm if you also need the change history (who removed/added) during the window.
• Redaction: we will by default obfuscate client_ip and remove internal ticket IDs. If Crowell & Park need full IPs under NDA, we can arrange secure transfer.

Tentative timeline: draft bridge letter and SOC2 redacted PDF by 2027-07-21; scoped log slices and access-review CSVs by 2027-07-21 as well, delivered via secure Share (or SFTP on request). Will that meet your 2027-08-15 auditor deadline?

I'll loop in Markus (infra) and Neha (security) to confirm the extraction steps and any retention constraints.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0202

Also include service-account rotation events for eligibly scoped accounts. We need to know export time and estimated size.

I'll prepare the bridge letter draft and SOC2 redacted copy. If extraction needs engineering time, let's estimate hours.

Thanks — Olga
